text: Callum and Yasmin got engaged over the weekend! He proposed in Edinburgh on their fifth anniversary. Wedding probably next summer.

Lunch with Siddharth. His manager, Moira, is leaving at the end of November and he's been asked to cover her accounts until they hire someone. He's pretty stressed about it, especially since the Banerjee renewal lands on November 20 and Moira was the one who knew that client inside out. He also said his wife Mai thinks he should push for a proper title change if he's doing the job anyway. I should ask him next week how the conversation with HR went.
Need to send Adaeze a card for her anniversary on June 3rd. Ten years with Kwame.
Housewarming at Ben's new flat on Saturday 11/8, from 7. I'm bringing dessert.

Marisol mentioned her sister Joy is getting married in Lisbon on May 14. She's maid of honour and already panicking about the speech. Joy's fiancé is Portuguese, so half the guests won't speak English, and Marisol is trying to learn enough to do a couple of lines in both. She's flying out the Thursday before and staying a week after for a bit of a holiday. Hen do is in April somewhere in Spain, still being argued about in the group chat.
Eli from accounts is vegan, and properly strict about it. Worth remembering for the Christmas lunch order.

Thomas's leaving drinks were meant to be Friday but they've been cancelled because half the team is off sick. Rescheduling to the week after, probably Thursday, though nobody has confirmed. Thomas seemed a bit flat about it, honestly. He's been at the company eleven years and was looking forward to a proper send-off. His new job at a startup in Manchester starts on November 16, so there isn't much slack. Worth checking with Hannah whether the gift money is still being collected.
Don't forget to ask Hannah how the client pitch went. It was Thursday morning and she'd been dreading it all week.
Rana's mum turns seventy on December 2nd and they're throwing a surprise dinner. Rana asked if I could help with the slideshow.
Quick one: Bilal and Zoe are celebrating their anniversary with a weekend in Bruges, leaving October 31 and back the Monday after.
Pick up the dry cleaning before Thursday and book the car in for its MOT.
Gabriel's new boss started last week. He says she's sharp but micromanages everything, and he already misses Stefan.
Call Dawit the day before his interview at Novak & Partners to wish him luck. Interview is November 4th at 10.
Mai has a rescue greyhound called Biscuit. Very shy, apparently terrified of the hoover.
Dinner at Andre and Ioana's on Friday. They've just had the kitchen redone and want to show it off. Ioana is gluten free, so no bread from the bakery.
Aidan Walsh, or Walshy as everyone calls him, has been made team lead. Announcement went out this morning. Must send him a congratulations message.
Sophie's brother Liam is getting married on 9/12 in Cork. She's flying out a week before to help with everything and coming back the day after.
Talked to Xavier after the all-hands. He's been offered a secondment in Toronto starting January 6. Hasn't decided yet, his partner isn't keen on moving.
Kate said she'd love one of those fancy olive oil sets. Her birthday is June 21st, so plenty of time.
Mandla's engagement party is March 7. I'm doing the playlist.
Hamza is nervous about his driving test on the 27th. Third attempt. I should text him good luck that morning and ask how it went afterwards.

Thabo's dad had his knee operation yesterday. Went fine, but he'll be off his feet for six weeks and Thabo is doing all the driving to and from the hospital. On top of that his little girl has chickenpox and his wife Joy is away for work until the 30th. He kept saying he's fine, but he clearly isn't sleeping. Must drop a meal round at the weekend and tell him to take Monday off if he needs it.

Remember: Kwame and Adaeze's anniversary dinner is at The Ivy on June 3, 8pm. Book a taxi. It's their tenth, and Kwame has secretly arranged for Adaeze's sister Rana to fly in from Lagos as a surprise. Rana lands on June 2nd, the day before, and is staying with us that night, so I need to make up the spare bed and keep it quiet when Adaeze calls. Absolutely do not mention it at work.
Miriam got the promotion! Senior counsel from December 1st. She found out on Monday and has told almost nobody yet.
The client from Costa Logistics, Mr Costa himself, wants a follow-up call next Tuesday. Siddharth will join. I need to prep the revised numbers the day before.
Ben is a huge Arsenal fan. Season ticket holder, goes to every home game with his uncle.
Callum asked me to be an usher at the wedding. Date is set: August 22nd, at Yasmin's parents' farm near York.
Stefan's wife Marisol had the baby on Sunday! A little girl, Ana. Should organise a gift from the team and send flowers to the house.
Lovely evening at Joy's birthday dinner. Her partner Eli cooked the whole thing. Joy mentioned she's started pottery classes on Wednesdays and is obsessed.
Liam's been struggling since the restructure. His role was merged with Bilal's and he feels sidelined. Grab a coffee with him next week, just to check in.
Rana and Gabriel are having a joint thirtieth on 4/18 at a bar in Shoreditch. Fancy dress, eighties theme.
Need to RSVP to Zoe's wedding by May 1st. Ceremony is June 20, reception afterwards at the golf club.
Hannah's anniversary with Thomas is on the 15th and she wants ideas for a present. He's into whisky and vinyl.
Aidan said the Banerjee account review got pushed to October 29. He's presenting, and he's quietly terrified. Text him the night before.
Mai and Xavier are moving in together at the start of December. Viewing a flat in Clapham on Saturday morning.
Hamza's grandad passed away last Thursday. Funeral is next Wednesday in Bradford. He's taking the week off. Send a card to his home.
Sophie's leaving do is next Friday, November 13. Collection going round for a gift. I've put in £20.
Kate was at the party with her new boyfriend, Dawit. Nice guy, works as a paramedic. They met at a climbing gym.

Thomas Osei, Tom to everyone, retires on 12/18 after thirty years at the firm. Big send-off planned for that evening. Ask Moira whether we're doing a card. Also, his wife wants to surprise him with a trip to New Zealand afterwards to see their son, who emigrated in 2019, so we should avoid anything bulky as a gift. Vouchers for the trip would go down well.
Groceries for Sunday lunch: lamb, rosemary, potatoes, mint sauce. Also wine.
Bilal just got back from his honeymoon in Sri Lanka. Hasn't stopped talking about it. He and his wife Rana are already planning the next trip.

Long catch-up with Ioana at the Santos launch event. She's leaving the agency in January to go freelance, which she's wanted for years, but she's nervous about money with the mortgage. Her husband Andre is supportive. She asked if I'd pass her name to any clients who need copywriting. Also mentioned their daughter starts primary school in September, and they're thinking about moving closer to her parents in Bath before then. Remember to introduce her to Callum, who needs a writer for the spring campaign.
Gabriel's sister Moira is getting married on July 10. He's giving a speech and asked me to read his draft. Must get back to him by the weekend.
Andre's anniversary is on 2/14, which he hates because restaurants are impossible. Fifteen years this time.
Adaeze told me at lunch that her mum is having a scan on Monday. She's worried. Text her that afternoon.
Stefan is allergic to nuts, seriously allergic. Don't bring the brownies to his barbecue.
Party at Marisol's on Halloween. Starts at 8. Costume optional, but she'd prefer we made an effort.
Callum's stag is the weekend of July 24 in Prague. Flights booked. Yasmin's hen is the same weekend, in Brighton.
Kwame's performance review is on Thursday. He thinks he's in line for a raise. Ask him how it went on Friday.
Interesting chat with Mandla about bonsai. He's had one of his trees for twenty years. Would make a good conversation starter with his clients too.
Joy and Aidan's wedding is off. They split up a couple of weeks ago, and Joy is moving back to her parents' place. Check in with her soon.
Note to self: dentist on November 3rd at 2:30. Leave work early.
Zoe Novak, my new manager, starts Monday. Seems friendly. Has two kids and a labrador named Pepper.
Big news from Siddharth: he and Hannah are expecting their first, due April 2nd. They're telling family this weekend.
Eli is running the half marathon on October 25 for a cancer charity. Sponsor him before the race and ask how it went the day after.
Dinner with Thabo and his partner. Thabo's training to be a sommelier and brought a ridiculous bottle of Barolo. His partner Kate is a teacher and loves it.

Ben's daughter has her ballet recital on December 5th. He asked if I'd come along, since his ex can't make it and he doesn't want to be sitting on his own. Said yes. It's at the community hall at 6, and there's a little party at their house afterwards. She's seven and apparently has a solo, which she's very serious about. Bring flowers for her at the end.
Yasmin mentioned she's been eyeing a Le Creuset casserole dish for months. Wedding gift idea, maybe, if it's not already on the list.

Met Xavier's girlfriend, Ioana, at his housewarming last night. They're throwing an engagement party in the spring. Marisol and Stefan were there too, with their new baby. Need to send Xavier a thank you text and drop off the plant I promised, maybe on Sunday. Ioana said Xavier has finally finished his model railway in the spare room and wants everyone to admire it.

Moira's husband Hamza has been off work since his back surgery in September. She's juggling everything and looks exhausted. I should take her out for lunch on Friday, and maybe offer to cover her Monday meeting with the MacDonald team.
